entwurf.thema: Levi's rivets and the myth of the unchanged jeans design

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Jeans rivets were scratching furniture. Popular lore says Levi's design never changed. Look closer.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: a man in a fedora, grey suit, dark tie and gold pocket watch frowns at a deep scratch on a polished wooden chair, vintage denim jeans draped beside it. Medium shot, warm lamplight.

teile.name: Patent
teile.text: Tailor Jacob Davis riveted strain points. He and Strauss won a patent in 1873.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style, 1870s Reno tailor shop: an illustrative period tailor hammers a copper rivet into the pocket corner of heavy denim trousers on a workbench. Close shot, golden window light.

teile.name: Wartime change
teile.text: So what changed? During World War II, metal conservation rules removed three features.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style, 1940s garment factory: illustrative workers at sewing machines stitch denim overalls, an inspector in the background watches. Wide shot, muted industrial light, wartime mood.

teile.name: What vanished
teile.text: The crotch rivet, waist cinch and watch pocket rivets vanished. Only the last returned.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style: macro view of a vintage blue jean's small watch pocket with one copper rivet, bare denim where other metal parts once sat. Close-up, dramatic side light.

teile.name: Covered rivets
teile.text: Back pocket rivets had been covered in denim since 1937 to prevent scratching furniture.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style, 1930s living room: a man in jeans sits down on a wooden chair, denim-covered back pockets pressed against the polished seat. Medium shot, soft afternoon light.

teile.name: Bar tacks
teile.text: Bar tacks replaced them in the 1950s. Rivets eventually wore through and scratched anyway.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style, 1950s workshop: a sewing machine stitches thick reinforcing bar tacks onto a denim back pocket, a worn rivet and a scratched chair leg visible beside it. Close shot, warm light.

teile.name: Engagement
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style: the fedora-wearing man in a grey suit with gold pocket watch smiles beside a scratched wooden chair, holding folded vintage jeans. Medium shot, warm evening light.

entwurf.beschreibung: Levi's lore says the jeans design never changed, but wartime metal rules and furniture scratches altered the rivets. A short look at what vanished, what returned and what replaced the back pocket rivets.
